payload.text: hv, 2026-09-21 ~21:45Z (vc read 21:54Z from date -u), on vc's CI-budget measurement (September to date 9149 weighted Actions minutes, devbin's macOS job 7400 of them): (1) a macOS job runs only on release tags and on demand, never on every push, in devbin and every repository with macOS artefacts; Ubuntu stays on push. (3) devbin goes public, but not before it is more stable: October or November. devbin's half is issue 0108 (dc builds, vc reviews, ships 0.1.6). The fleet half is a pass tomorrow, each estate in its own tree. hv topped up the budget by 10 pounds the same evening. v0.1.5 released 21:53Z: tag ca5ea90 at 3b60b0d on both remotes, the release object made by the workflow.
